rule: Only immutable approved experiment specs may enter QUEUED.
notes: Any config/data/code change creates a new experiment identity.

rule: Research/HPO may read development history/selection only; protected holdout and forward shadow are never HPO objectives.
Each active experiment uses an isolated worktree or immutable source snapshot.
notes: No direct mutation of canonical branch.

rule: Experiment-local outputs live outside repository ZIP raw-data/model-binary paths.
Retry with changed config is a child/new experiment ID, never silent mutation.
Paid/remote compute requires explicit resource-budget approval.
Bounded concurrency must respect local RAM/GPU/worktree constraints.
notes: Idle compute does not authorize future-wave work.

rule: Protected judging-rule seal must verify before execution and before result adoption.
Promotion is not a research-queue state; it occurs only via external W17 promotion governor.
